item.title: Bins being left in a public car park, not being returned and being filled by non residents, 25th July
item.description:
After repeated requests to the crew to return the bins to the allocated bin area, the crew continue to leave the bins outside of the gated grounds of the building. The bins have recently been left in the car park where they are now used by the general public for general refuse. This has now resulted in the bins not being emptied by the very crew that left these bins in a public area because they are full of general refuse instead of recyclable material. The crew take the bins from the allocated enclosed bin area at the property, empty them, then leave them in the public car park. This is unacceptable, lazy and unprofessional.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Waldegrave Road, Crystal Palace, Greater London
